[Benzinga news, 2026-10-27T13:02:01Z, by staff] INNIO N.V. Reports Record Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
INNIO N.V. announced record third-quarter 2026 financial results, featuring a 57% year-over-year revenue increase to $1.2 billion and a 176% rise in net income, while raising its full-year 2026 outlook.
INNIO N.V. reported record quarterly revenue of $1.2 billion for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, representing a 57% increase compared to the same period last year. Net income reached $109.2 million, up 176% year-over-year, while Adjusted EBITDA grew 70% to $245.4 million. Driven by strong performance in data center deliveries and services, the company raised its fiscal 2026 guidance, now expecting total revenue between $3.9 billion and $4.0 billion and Adjusted EBITDA between $780 million and $800 million. CFO Dr. Dennis Schulze attributed the growth to accelerating demand for AI infrastructure, noting that the company has achieved over $6 billion in equipment order intake year-to-date.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-27T12:59:10Z, by Kaustubh Bagalkote] American Tower Raises Its 2026 Outlook For Third Time
American Tower (AMT) beats Q3 estimates with $2.87 AFFO/share, delivers $2.78B in revenue, and raises its full-year 2026 outlook.
American Tower Corp. (NYSE: AMT ) reported third-quarter earnings Tuesday that topped Wall Street estimates for earnings and revenue . The company also raised the midpoint of its 2026 outlook for property revenue and adjusted funds from operations (AFFO) per share. American Tower reported adjusted funds from operations (AFFO) of $2.87 per share, above the analyst consensus estimate of $2.68 and up from $2.78 per share a year earlier . GAAP diluted earnings per share were $1.64, down from $1.82 in the year-ago period. Revenue rose 2.5% to $2.785 billion from $2.717 billion a year earlier, exceeding the consensus estimate of $2.761 billion, according to Benzinga Pro . Revised 2026 Guidance American Tower narrowed its full-year AFFO per-share guidance to $11.04 to $11.16 from $11 to $11.17. Analysts had expected $10.85 per share . The company attributed the 2-cent increase in the midpoint primarily to capital allocation decisions. The company raised the midpoint of its property revenue outlook by $55 million, citing performance in its data centers segment, while leaving its adjusted EBITDA midpoint unchanged. American Tower lowered the midpoint of its net income outlook by $30 million, primarily due to unrealized losses on equity securities. See More: Top Value Stocks Cash Flow and Balance Sheet AFFO attributable to common stockholders, a cash-based earnings measure, rose 2.4% to $1.335 billion. The company reported $1.872 billion in cash and cash equivalents. Its net leverage ratio, calculated as net debt divided by annualized adjusted EBITDA, stood at 4.9 times. Third-Quarter Operating Results Total property revenue rose 4.5% to $2.734 billion, driven by 1.1% organic tenant billings growth and a 16.3% increase in cash revenue from its data centers segment. Adjusted EBITDA, a profitability measure that excludes certain expenses, rose 0.9% to $1.832 billion. Net income fell 14.4% to $781 million, while net income attributable to common stockholders declined 10.3% to $766 million. The company said unrealized losses on equity investments of approximately $71.5 million, compared with gains of about $10.9 million a year earlier, weighed on the year-over-year net income comparison. Stock Repurchase Expansion American Tower repurchased approximately $315 million of its shares during the quarter and an additional $68 million through Oct. 20. On Oct. 23, the company’s board authorized up to $2 billion in additional share repurchases, supplementing approximately $1.1 billion remaining under its existing program. The company also declared a quarterly distribution of $1.79 per share, up 5.3% from a year earlier. American Tower expects to complete the sale of its Canadian subsidiaries for approximately $202 million in the fourth quarter. Management Commentary “We delivered another solid quarter, supported by consistent leasing demand across our global tower portfolio and continued outperformance from CoreSite ,” CEO Steve Vondran said in the earnings release. Vondran said the company has raised its full-year outlook three times in 2026. AMT Price Action: American Tower shares were down 1.69% at $185.10 during premarket trading on Tuesday, according to Benzinga Pro data .
